title: South Africa national grid emission factor
description: CO2 per MWh of electricity SOLD by Eskom (sales are after T&D losses, own use and wheeling, and include IPP purchases), i.e. a delivered-electricity factor suited to low-voltage consumption. ecoinvent 3.11's ZA low-voltage market characterises to only ~0.32 kgCO2e/kWh in this store (ReCiPe 2016 H), which a coal-dominated grid cannot produce; the official Eskom factor is ~3.3x higher.

per_generated.use_for: Factor 2, per MWh generated less pumped-storage consumption (not used by the engine).

provenance.table: Integrated report 2024, p 122, 'Environmental implications of using or saving electricity'
provenance.span: 190.4Mt of CO2 / 183 311GWh sales = 1.04 tons per MWh. Figures represent the 12-month period from 1 April 2023 to 31 March 2024.
provenance.publication: Eskom Holdings SOC Ltd (2024) Integrated Report 2024
